retry.recommendation: Add retry with exponential backoff for transient network failures during push

circuit_breaker.recommendation: Add circuit breaker per remote to avoid repeated failures to unreachable remotes

bulkhead.recommendation: Limit concurrent push mirror syncs to prevent resource exhaustion

fallback.recommendation: Record failure in last_error and continue; already partially implemented

idempotency.reason: Git push --mirror is idempotent - pushing same refs again is safe

blast_radius.impact: If remote is down, push_mirrors-sync blocks for timeout duration per mirror, potentially causing HTTP timeout for the caller

findings.detail: Async queue push - fire and forget pattern is resilient

endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: None - async queue decouples from actual sync
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Queue handles backpressure via unique queue deduplication

findings.detail: Git push has timeout but total request time = N * timeout which can exceed HTTP timeouts
findings.recommendation: Make sync async or add overall request timeout

findings.detail: No retry on transient push failures
findings.recommendation: Add retry logic for network errors

findings.detail: No circuit breaker - will attempt push to known-failing remotes
findings.recommendation: Skip mirrors with recent last_error or implement circuit breaker

findings.detail: Fails on first mirror error, leaving remaining mirrors unsynced
findings.recommendation: Continue syncing remaining mirrors even if one fails

non_atomic_operations: Partial sync - some mirrors synced, some not, if error occurs mid-loop
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: One slow/failing remote blocks all subsequent mirrors in the loop
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Returns 500 on first failure, partial sync state

findings.detail: DB insert + git remote add are not atomic, but cleanup is implemented on failure
DNS lookup in IsMigrateURLAllowed has no explicit timeout

non_atomic_operations: DB insert then git remote add - cleanup on failure implemented
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: DNS resolution hang could block request
endpoint_resiliency.graceful_degradation: Cleanup deletes DB record if git remote registration fails

findings.detail: Only deletes DB record, does not remove git remote config - leaves orphaned state
findings.recommendation: Add git remote removal before DB delete

non_atomic_operations: DB record deleted but git remote config remains
endpoint_resiliency.cascading_failure_risk: None for the request itself, but leaves inconsistent state

graceful_shutdown.detail: graceful.GetManager() handles shutdown context for mirror queue

rate_limiting.detail: No rate limiting on mirror sync endpoints
rate_limiting.recommendation: Add rate limiting to prevent abuse of sync endpoints which trigger expensive git operations

dead_letter_queues.detail: Mirror queue has no DLQ - failed syncs are logged but not retried from queue
dead_letter_queues.recommendation: Add retry mechanism or DLQ for failed mirror sync operations

single_points_of_failure: Mirror queue (single instance, no redundancy unless backed by Redis)
cascading_failure_paths: Remote git server down → ep-235 blocks for full timeout × N mirrors → HTTP timeout for caller
